review_evidence: Inspected the hydrated ACL2 workshop unit across all 373 currently primary files. The retained .lisp developments contain the definitions/theorems, and nonempty .sys useless-runes files preserve proof-use metadata.

Complete-file screening of the non-.sys .acl2/.lsp wrappers distinguished 14 exact certification/load/build drivers from formal sources. In particular books/workshops/1999/knuth-91/certify.lsp is deliberately retained because it owns three defpkg declarations, while the selected wrappers own only loading, include-book, certify-book, compile-pipeline or session control.

Representative retained material includes the graph, Ivy, mu-calculus, multiplier, pipeline, STE and workshop proof developments; exercise/checker/utility sources and documentation are retained rather than classified by path name.

rules.content_invariant: Every selected file was inspected completely and contains only package/book loading, include-book context, certification commands, compilation orchestration or session control for separately retained formal sources; none owns a definition, theorem, package declaration, proof, reusable formal interface or standalone formal example.
evidence: Complete inspection covered all 14 selected wrapper/driver files.
The superficially similar knuth-91/certify.lsp was inspected and excluded from this selector because its defpkg declarations are unique formal interface content.
rules.rationale: Remove exact ACL2 certification/load/build wrappers whose formal content lives in separately retained books.

summary: Reviewed this ACL2 workshop slice; retain formal developments, package-defining sources, examples/utilities and nonempty proof metadata, excluding only exact declaration-free certification/load/build wrappers.
